answer: Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the shale of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The whisper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, forfeited on duplicate submission. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
